description: This file defines the WidgetFactory class, responsible for creating instances of ModelScreenWidget based on XML elements within the OFBiz framework. It loads standard widgets, registers custom widgets, and provides methods to obtain widget instances for a given screen and XML element.

classes.name: WidgetFactory
classes.description: A factory class that manages the creation and registration of widget components based on XML tags within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getModelScreenWidget
methods.description: Creates and returns a ModelScreenWidget instance for a given screen and XML element based on registered widget classes.

methods.name: loadStandardWidgets
methods.description: Loads the standard OFBiz widget classes and registers them with the factory.

methods.name: registerScreenWidget
methods.description: Registers a widget class with a specific XML tag name for later instantiation.
